design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g., deep blue) for table headers, pull-quote rule, and sidebar border.
Set all body text in a serif font (e.g., Georgia or Chronicle).
Apply a hairline rule above and below the pull-quote; no decorative icons.
Place the financials table after the paragraph introducing it; the sidebar after the 'offer' section; the pull-quote after the paragraph describing the business.
